observation: A compound reduces seizures in a WWOX model and is catalogued as a T-type blocker
relation_hypothesised: Catalogue label implies WWOX seizures involve T-type channels and a specific isoform (report calls this an invalid leap)
possible_action: Do not assume; test with genetics and orthogonal chemistry
context: Hypothetical WWOX model; no such experiment identified
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=not identified in report; relation=inferred and rejected; action=none
favourable_reason: None offered; the report argues against the leap
unfavourable_or_alternative: Labels pan-isoform; polypharmacology; T-type-independent effects possible
discriminating_experiment: Matching Cacna KO cross plus selective antagonist concordance plus enantiomer control plus allele stratification
reasoning_pattern: A drug-catalogue target annotation is not carried to a disease model without a target-dependence test

observation: WWOX loss gives metabolic stress/hypoglycaemia in mice (rescued by neuronal WWOX); HIF1alpha upregulates Cav3.2; Cav3.2 induction drives pilocarpine epileptogenesis
relation_hypothesised: WWOX loss, metabolic stress, HIF1alpha, CACNA1H upregulation, hyperexcitability, genotype-dependent T-type sensitivity
possible_action: Test Cav3.2-directed block in WWOX models; measure Cacna1h with HIF1alpha inhibition
context: Mouse Wwox-null; HIF1alpha study system not stated; pilocarpine epilepsy model
benefit_to_verify: Seizure suppression by T-type block that depends on Cav3.2 and allele class
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (metabolic phenotype; HIF1alpha-Cav3.2 in another system); relation=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Each step has a separate citation, except metabolic stress to HIF1alpha, which has none
unfavourable_or_alternative: Chain never shown in a WWOX model; stress-to-HIF1alpha step unsourced; semiology mismatch; general anticonvulsant default
discriminating_experiment: Quantify Cacna1g/h/i mRNA, protein, T-type current by allele class with and without HIF1alpha inhibition
reasoning_pattern: Mechanisms from separate systems are linked into one chain through shared nodes (metabolic stress, HIF1alpha)

observation: CACNA1H variants raise excitability and are reversed by ethosuximide or TTA-P2; CACNA1H is associated with DEE, GGE, and with seizure modulation
relation_hypothesised: CACNA1H/Cav3.2 is the isoform most likely to mediate any T-type effect in WWOX-DEE
possible_action: Use ethosuximide plus TTA-P2 concordance in WWOX models; prioritise Cacna1h KO cross
context: CACNA1H variant expression systems; human DEE/GGE cohorts; no WWOX context
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured in variant systems and cohorts; relation=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Three stated convergences: HIF1alpha target, epileptogenesis driver, DEE association
unfavourable_or_alternative: Ethosuximide is T-type-independent in worm (so reversal by it is weak evidence); variant disorders differ from WWOX; no WWOX data
discriminating_experiment: Wwox-null x Cacna1h KO: abolished only on Cacna1h KO
reasoning_pattern: Evidence that a gene is implicated in other epilepsies is transferred to a different disorder through the shared phenotype (epilepsy)

observation: Z941/Z944 suppress absence seizures by a mechanism distinct from ethosuximide and valproate; Z944 anti-epileptogenic in TLE model
relation_hypothesised: Structurally unrelated selective antagonists reproducing an effect indicate a genuine T-type mechanism
possible_action: Test Z944, Z941, TTA-P2, ulixacaltamide with ethosuximide in WWOX model
context: Rodent absence and TLE models; WWOX model proposed
benefit_to_verify: Seizure reduction attributable to T-type block
favourable_reason: Chemotype convergence is a recognised attribution criterion
unfavourable_or_alternative: Selectivity across Cav3.1/3.2/3.3 imperfect; antagonists may share other actions
discriminating_experiment: Concordance panel plus Cav3-null backgrounds (effect retained there implies off-target)
reasoning_pattern: Agreement across unrelated chemotypes is used as a proxy for target engagement

observation: Ethosuximide anticonvulsant action persists in a cca-1 null worm; mibefradil blocks Orai
relation_hypothesised: Annotated T-type drugs may act through other targets (off-target polypharmacology)
possible_action: Treat the T-type label as non-informative; include Cav3-null backgrounds
favourable_reason: Direct null experiment shows target independence for ethosuximide
unfavourable_or_alternative: Worm ortholog may not equal mammalian Cav3 pharmacology (not stated by report)
discriminating_experiment: All Cav3-null backgrounds with selective tool compounds (E4 prediction)
reasoning_pattern: A null of the putative target that leaves the drug effect intact shows target independence

observation: Biallelic-null WWOX alleles carry more severe metabolic and survival phenotype than hypomorphic-missense
relation_hypothesised: Genotype-dependent T-type sensitivity should track allele severity; general anticonvulsant should not
possible_action: Compare T-type drug sensitivity across allele classes
context: WWOX allele-class models (mouse or neurons); not specified
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured in knowledge base (survival); relation=inferred; action=speculative
unfavourable_or_alternative: Requires models of both allele classes; sensitivity gradient could reflect severity alone
discriminating_experiment: Allele-class stratification of baseline seizure burden and drug response
reasoning_pattern: A dose-response gradient across genotype severity separates a mechanism-specific effect from a generic one

observation: Lithium abolishes PTZ seizures in Wwox-/- mice; WWOX scaffold loss de-repress GSK-3beta
relation_hypothesised: The seizure mechanism in WWOX-DEE is scaffold/GSK-3beta-centred rather than T-type
unfavourable_or_alternative: Lithium also has non-GSK-3beta actions (not stated by report)
reasoning_pattern: The only drug-linked mechanism in a curated source is taken as the default

observation: Cav3 KOs can increase SWD susceptibility; de novo CACNA1G variant without seizures
relation_hypothesised: Isoform contributions are non-uniform, so pharmacology cannot assign an isoform
possible_action: Use genetic crosses for isoform attribution
context: Mouse SWD models; human CACNA1G case
favourable_reason: Supports the requirement for genetic controls
unfavourable_or_alternative: Isoform paradoxes are from thalamic models, not WWOX
discriminating_experiment: Single versus combined Cav3 KO in Wwox-null background
reasoning_pattern: A counterintuitive sign of a gene knockout in one model undermines drug-label inference

relation_hypothesised: If the drug works there, activity is general anticonvulsant rather than WWOX-specific
possible_action: Run the same drug in PTZ and kainate models
benefit_to_verify: Distinguish E5 from E1 to E4

discriminating_experiment: Cross-model drug test with allele-class comparison
reasoning_pattern: A shared effect across unrelated disease models marks a general rather than disease-specific mechanism
